name: magnetic-dropzone
title: Magnetic Dropzone
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Drop zone that leans toward the pointer, with a file list, progress, and type and size checks.

meta.descriptionEs: Zona para soltar archivos que se inclina hacia el cursor, con lista, progreso y validación de tipo y tamaño.

examples.title: Zona magnética
examples.description: Zona para soltar archivos que se inclina hacia el cursor, con lista, progreso y validación de tipo y tamaño.

api.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
api.description: Validation. maxSize defaults to 8 MB and maxFiles to 8.

api.name: items / onItemsChange
api.description: Controlled list. Omit items for internal state.

api.name: simulateProgress
api.description: Animates progress for demos. Default false.

api.name: labels
api.description: label, hint, remove, too large, and type labels default to English.

docs: The lean is disabled when the reader prefers reduced motion. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
